mapper.sql: r.report_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reporter_user_id, r.reporter_user_type, r.source_url, r.menu_id, r.reason_code, r.reason_text, r.status, r.reviewed_by, r.reviewed_at, r.review_note, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_report (report_id, target_type, target_id, reporter_user_id, reporter_user_type, source_url, menu_id, reason_code, reason_text, status, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reporterUserId}, #{reporterUserType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{menuId}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonText}, 'PENDING', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
SELECT , r.created_at AS created_at_view, COALESCE(a.title, LEFT(c.content, 60)) AS target_title, COALESCE(a.writer_name, c.writer_name) AS target_writer, COALESCE(a.status, c.status) AS target_status, COALESCE(a.article_id, c.article_id) AS article_id, m.bbs_master_id, m.bbs_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_report r2 WHERE r2.target_type = r.target_type AND r2.target_id = r.target_id AND r2.delete_yn = 'N' AND r2.status <> 'REJECTED') AS report_count FROM tb_bbs_report r LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_article a ON r.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND a.article_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_comment c ON r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.comment_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_article ca ON ca.article_id = c.article_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = COALESCE(a.bbs_master_id, ca.bbs_master_id)
ORDER BY r.status = 'PENDING' DESC, r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM tb_bbs_report r WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_report SET status = #{status}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{reviewedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_bbs_article a SET a.report_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_report r WHERE r.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND r.target_id = a.article_id AND r.delete_yn = 'N' AND r.status <> 'REJECTED'), a.updated_at = a.updated_at WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId}

UPDATE tb_bbs_comment c SET c.report_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_report r WHERE r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND r.target_id = c.comment_id AND r.delete_yn = 'N' AND r.status <> 'REJECTED'), c.updated_at = c.updated_at WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
